Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.mandela.values

Class MandelaError

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Throwable
java.lang.Exception
java.lang.RuntimeException
org.jdesktop.lg3d.mandela.values.MandelaError
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class MandelaError extends RuntimeException
A Mandela error: a value in the script and the throwable that unwinds the machine, in one object.

Scripts see it as an ordinary value — err is Err, err.message, str(err) — and try / catch binds it to the clause name. It is also a RuntimeException because that is how the language reaches out of a deep expression, through a host function, and back into the interpreter loop without checking a return code at every step. The two roles do not leak: a host that lets a MandelaError escape a HostFunction gets the same object the script threw, and a catch in the script sees a Java exception raised by the host wrapped as a RuntimeError with the original as its cause.

kind() is the discriminator scripts branch on, and the name the throw statement and the standard library use: ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, IndexError, RangeError, PermissionError, LimitError, IOError, RuntimeError.
